Draft — pending legal and language review. Operational details marked pending must be confirmed before launch.

HEACH connects people in Odisha with independent care providers for physiotherapy, nursing, attendant care and lab tests. HEACH is not an emergency service.

grievance.title: Grievance officer and complaints
grievance.body:
Draft — pending legal and language review. Operational details marked pending must be confirmed before launch.

Officer name, email, phone and response time: pending confirmation. Signed-in patients can report a concern from a booking and track its status. Include the booking reference, describe the concern privately and keep the complaint reference. Escalation contact and deadlines await legal review.

provider-agreement.title: Provider agreement
provider-agreement.body:
Draft — pending legal and language review. Operational details marked pending must be confirmed before launch.

Providers must supply accurate identity and qualification documents, obtain approval before listing, keep availability and prices current, protect patient information and deliver only services they are qualified to provide. Commission, payouts, cancellation, replacement and dispute terms require legal approval before live use.

patient-rights.title: Patient rights
patient-rights.body:
Draft — pending legal and language review. Operational details marked pending must be confirmed before launch.

You can see prices before paying, choose your provider, consent to sharing records, revoke sharing, see record access history and raise a complaint. Account settings offer correction, export and deletion requests. Retention and response deadlines await legal confirmation.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.body:
Draft — pending legal and language review. Operational details marked pending must be confirmed before launch.

HEACH connects you with independent care providers. Review the provider, service, full price, cancellation terms and location before booking. Consent is needed for identity checks and sharing records. Use only accurate information and raise concerns through the booking or grievance process. HEACH is not for emergencies: call 108. Company details, dispute terms and final contractual wording await lawyer approval.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.body:
Draft — pending legal and language review. Operational details marked pending must be confirmed before launch.

We use account and booking information to arrange care. Health records are encrypted and private; sharing is controlled by the patient and access is recorded. Aadhaar numbers are not stored in full. Account settings support correction, export and deletion requests. Retention periods, response deadlines, company contact and the final privacy notice await legal confirmation.

refunds.title: Cancellation and refunds
refunds.body:
Draft — pending legal and language review. Operational details marked pending must be confirmed before launch.

Check the cancellation and refund terms shown before you pay. Eligible refunds return to the original payment method. If a provider declines or does not accept in time, the booking is cancelled and the amount paid is refunded. For attendant shifts already started, refunds cover unworked shifts under the booking policy. Final deadlines, replacement terms and dispute wording await owner and lawyer approval.

faq.title: Questions and answers
faq.body:
Draft — pending legal and language review. Operational details marked pending must be confirmed before launch.

Can I book for family?
Yes. Add a person and select who will receive care.

How do I check availability?
Enter your PIN code, choose a service and check open times.

Are prices shown before payment?
Yes. Review the service fee, travel charges and discounts before paying.

Can I cancel?
Read the cancellation terms at checkout and the refund policy.

Who can see my records?
Your records are private. You control sharing and can inspect access history.

Is this for emergencies?
Call 108. Do not wait for an online booking.

1.question: Who carries out nursing visits?
1.answer: An approved nurse or paramedical provider carries out the listed procedure. Check their qualifications and registration on the profile.

attendant.included: Day, night or full-day bedside assistance. Review tasks, shift length and replacement terms before booking.
attendant.qualifications: Identity and address checks, a reference and training certificate where held; admin approval. Attendants do not replace qualified nurses.

0.question: Can I choose day or night attendant care?
0.answer: Choose a published day, night or full-day shift. The listing shows the shift duration, setting and fee.

1.question: Can an attendant perform nursing procedures?
1.answer: Attendants help with daily care. Book a qualified nurse separately for clinical procedures.

lab.included: Book lab tests with home sample collection or a lab visit. Review preparation instructions and collection charges. Reports are added to your vault.
lab.qualifications: Lab registration and authorised signatory identity checked. Accreditation is shown only when held. Collectors must be linked to an approved lab.

0.question: Can a lab collect my sample at home?
0.answer: Choose a test and a listing that offers home collection. Available collection times are shown before booking.

1.question: Where will I find my lab report?
1.answer: When the lab publishes your report, you can open it from your booking and your private records.
